items.headline: O: Health in ChatGPT
items.summary: O released “Health in ChatGPT,” describing physician testing and connected health-data use, alongside model evaluation claims for health tasks. Signals product expansion into clinical-adjacent workflows.

items.headline: O: O Presence
items.summary: O introduced “O Presence,” positioning it as a new product capability and company announcement. Materiality centers on potential distribution/capability expansion for downstream integrations.

items.headline: G: $650M inference cloud funding
items.summary: G announced $650M in new growth capital to scale its AI inference cloud, including near-term leadership appointments (CTO and CPO) tied to product expansion. Reinforces runway/capacity investment.
